hero.title: Dream Frequency
hero.subtitle: Visualizing the Subconscious via AI & EEG

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem Role
ecosystem.desc: Dream Frequency is the **Experimental Micro Moon**. It explores new frontiers of human-machine interface, testing emerging technologies (Brain-Computer Interfaces) that could one day integrate into other ecosystems.

s1.title: 1. Problem
s1.desc: We spend one-third of our lives sleeping, yet this vast amount of cognitive and emotional data is lost. There is no feedback loop that allows us to 'see' the quality of our rest beyond cold charts, losing the opportunity for creative introspection and mental well-being.

s2.title: 2. Solution
s2.desc: A multimodal system combining a non-invasive EEG headband (like Muse/OpenBCI) with Generative AI pipelines. The system translates brain frequencies (Alpha, Theta, Delta) into dynamic prompts to generate visual and sound dreamscapes in real-time.

s3.title: 3. Expected Results (Simulated)
s3.i1: Tech Demo: Functional pipeline mapping Theta waves to Stable Diffusion image generation.
s3.i2: Accuracy: > 80% correlation between detected emotional state and visual output (subjective validation).
s3.i3: Privacy: Local processing (Edge AI) to ensure 'dreams' never leave the user's device.

s4.title: 4. Business Model
s4.i2: App Subscription: Access to the 'Dream Gallery' and advanced sleep analysis.

s5.title: 5. Tech & Stack
s5.i2: AI Pipeline: Signal Processing (MNE-Python) -> Feature Extraction -> Prompt Engineering -> GenAI (Stable Diffusion/AudioCraft).

s6.title: 6. Status & Roadmap
s6.status: Status: Conceptual Proof of Concept and software architecture validation.
s6.i2: Q1 2027: Beta testing with a selected group of 'lucid dreamers'.

s7.title: 7. My Role
s7.i1: Product vision and systemic integration (Neuroscience + AI).

s8.title: 8. Sustainability (ESG)
s8.i1: Mental Health: Non-pharmacological tool for awareness and stress management.
s8.i2: Data Ethics: 'Privacy-by-default' design returning brain data ownership to the user.
